art_direction: 长而低的细线上缘像屋檐，双瞳轻向右，短下线留空，眉笔平稳。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Give the eyes long low upper contours, almost level through the middle before curving down at the ends. Use one pen stroke per upper edge and only a short lower fragment. Large black pupils look right together. Reserve broad crooked vertical gaps inside them, keeping the dark forms more important than the outlines. Flat iris accents occupy the remaining side spaces. Add two brief nearly level eyebrow strokes, one ending early. Keep the pair balanced on blank paper, with no mouth.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
